stem: With which of the following arguments would the authors of The Federalist Papers most likely have agreed?

options.label: F
options.text: A bill of rights should be included in the Constitution before it is ratified.

options.label: G
options.text: Having a stronger central government will make the country more stable and prosperous.

options.label: H
options.text: The Three-Fifths Compromise will result in fair and equal representation.

options.label: J
options.text: Universal suffrage should be constitutionally guaranteed.
